name: EXM_EXPENSE_DAILY_AMOUNTS
description: This table contains the cumulative daily amounts for the expenses created by an employee on a specific date for a specific expense policy line.

columns.name: DAILY_LIMIT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the daily limit line.

columns.name: DAY_OF_YEAR
columns.description: Day of the year in which the expense that is considered as a daily expense was created.

columns.name: EXPENSE_CREATION_YEAR
columns.description: Year in which the daily expense was created.

columns.name: POLICY_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the policy line.

columns.name: CUMULATIVE_DAILY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of the cumulative daily amounts in USD for the expenses created by an employee on a specific date.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.
